lines.1: 「I will introduce the student council members.」
lines.3: 「Student Council Vice President: Otome Kurogane, also Chair of the Disciplinary Committee.」
lines.6: 「We lack manpower. We would like your assistance.」
lines.7: 「That's the situation. Most people help when we ask, so we made do with that. But we really do want formal members.」
lines.9: 「They annoyed me, so I fired them.」
lines.10: There it was: the Princess's special move, doing whatever she pleased.
lines.11: 「Hey, Princess. Isn't it a problem to fire people whenever you feel like it?」
lines.12: 「I don't care. My decisions are absolute.」
lines.14: 「Even so, the Princess is well respected. Many students come to interview. Their ability should be adequate, yet she rejects every one.」
lines.15: 「I'll take someone I like. I just haven't liked any of them.」
lines.16: 「Then why did all four of us pass?」
lines.19: 「Date aside, you all seemed fundamentally idle.」
lines.20: 「Ahaha! She called you lazy! You look so stupid!」
lines.22: 「But that is not the primary reason. You trade insults constantly, but you trust one another. What we need is teamwork.」
lines.24: 「My main reason is that you seem fun.」
lines.26: 「But it's important, isn't it? Have a pleasant time.」
lines.28: 「No. Adding four people would be a great help.」
lines.29: She gave us a gentle smile.
lines.31: 「So Otome never asked the four of you. What do you say? Will you help?」
lines.33: 「We'll account for that. We mainly need extra hands. Of course, you will have to do a little work.」
lines.35: A true deadbeat. Anything formal triggered an allergic reaction in her.
lines.36: 「Hmm. It annoys me to have someone refuse after I approved them. Fine. You can decide after you see Ryugu--your prospective workplace.」
lines.37: 「I will join you after checking on the training halls. When I glanced in earlier, the club members lacked spirit.」
lines.38: They must have been slacking while the demon was away.
lines.39: 「We will go to the executive committee's hideout.」
lines.42: For quiet Sato, she denied it with an unusually proud air.
lines.43: So it was not run-down, then.
